    σ.pend

    snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists

def memSnapRO (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
      sync.isMutex (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"Mutex" ms) (memstorageInv ms γs) ∗
        inv memSnapN (memSnapInv ms γs))

theorem memStorApplied.proj_sdat (snap : SnapshotM) : (memStorApplied snap).sdat = snap.Data'

theorem memTermsPre_persistent (γs : MemStorNames) (ts : List w64) : Persistent (memTermsPre γs ts)

theorem memSnapKeys_excl [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (k j : Nat) : ⊢ memSnapKeys
    γs k -∗ memSnapKeys γs j -∗ False

theorem HistOk.le_last' {L : List StorState} {w : StorState} (H : HistOk L) (hw : L.getLast? = some
    w) (a : StorState) : a ∈ L → uint.Z a.fl ≤ uint.Z w.fl ∧ uint.Z a.hd ≤ uint.Z w.hd ∧ FloorKept a
    w

def certCovers (e : CertKey) (k : SnapTrip) : Prop :=
  if e.snd = true then e.fst.sid.index' = k.sid.index' ∧ e.fst.cl = k.cl ∧ e.fst.al = k.al ∧ e.fst.dat = k.dat
  else e.fst = k

theorem memSnapTokG_timeless (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) : Timeless (memSnapTokG γs σ)

theorem DataEq.refl (a : StorState) : DataEq a a

def memKey (γ : GName) : IProp GF :=
  ghostVar γ 1 ()

structure MemStorNames : Type where
  hist : GName
  done : GName
  ep : GName
  sn : GName
  sw : GName
  lk : GName
  ok : GName
  ak : GName
  cb : GName
  bd : GName
  cap : Int
  cert : GName

def memAppendTok (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("#Hinit" ∷ isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
      "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isMutex (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"Mutex" ms) (memstorageInv ms γs) ∗
        ∃ E H D,
          "Hdone" ∷ monoListAuthOwn γs.done (Qp.half 1) D ∗
            "#Hhlb" ∷
                monoListLbOwn γs.hist
                  (H ++
                    [storAbsorb
                        { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                          sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }]) ∗
              "Hep" ∷ monoListAuthOwn γs.ep (Qp.half 1) E ∗
                "%Htok" ∷
                  ⌜E.getLast? =
                        some
                          ({ prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                              sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd },
                            H, D) ∧
                      EpOk E ∧
                        H.getLast? = some σ ∧
                          σ.pend = [] ∧
                            PendOk σ p ∧
                              PendAbove σ p ∧
                                HdAbove σ p ∧
                                  D <+: H ∧
                                    D ≠ [] ∧
                                      RaiseOnly D (List.drop D.length H) ∧
                                        HistOk
                                          (H ++
                                            [storAbsorb
                                                { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs,
                                                  sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }])⌝)

def CertKey : Type :=
  SnapTrip × Bool

theorem CutOk.self (σ : StorState) : CutOk σ σ.prev

    σ)

    : 0 ≤ m) : ⊢ memStorCut γs n -∗ memStorCut γs m

    γs x)

def memSnapN : Namespace :=
  nroot.@"raft_memsnap"

theorem DataEq.symm {a b : StorState} (h : DataEq a b) : DataEq b a

def memFloorTok (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (x : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("#Hinit" ∷ isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
      "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isMutex (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"Mutex" ms) (memstorageInv ms γs) ∗
        "#Hfl" ∷ memFlLb γs x ∗ "#Hhd" ∷ memHdLb γs x)

    = σ.scs) (h3 : σ'.sal = σ.sal) (h4 : σ'.sdat = σ.sdat) : memSnapCertOk γs σ ⊢ memSnapCertOk γs
    σ'

theorem memStorCut_cap (γs : MemStorNames) (n : Int) : ⊢ memStorCut γs n -∗ ⌜n ≤ γs.cap⌝

theorem memFloorTok_last [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σp : StorState)
    (x : w64) : ⊢ memFloorTok ms γs x -∗ memInvGhost γs σp -∗ ⌜uint.Z x ≤ stLast σp⌝ ∗ memInvGhost
    γs σp

def memSnapShare (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(inv memSnapN (memSnapInv ms γs) ∗ memKey γs.ok)

theorem storApp_memCut {σ : StorState} {c : entryID} (h : CutOk σ c) (p : List EntryM) (hp : ∀ (e0 :
    EntryM), p.head? = some e0 → uint.Z c.index' < uint.Z e0.Index') : storApp (memCut σ c) p =
    List.drop (uint.Z c.index' - uint.Z σ.prev.index').toNat (storApp σ p)

theorem EpOk.last_le {E1 E2 : List MemEp} {e1 e2 : MemEp} (h : E1 <+: E2) (H : EpOk E2) (h1 :
    E1.getLast? = some e1) (h2 : E2.getLast? = some e2) : epK e1 <+: epK e2

theorem memCut_view [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (σ σ0 : StorState) (c : entryID)
    : ⊢ memView γs σ -∗ memInvGhost γs σ0 -∗ memCutInv γs σ0 c -∗ ⌜MemView σ σ0 ∧ CutOk σ0 c ∧ (c =
    σ0.prev ∨ uint.Z c.index' ≤ uint.Z σ.fl)⌝ ∗ memStorCut γs (uint.Z c.index') ∗ memView γs σ ∗
    memInvGhost γs σ0 ∗ memCutInv γs σ0 c

def memstorageInv (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ σp c,
      "Hgs" ∷ memInvGhost γs σp ∗
        "Hfields" ∷ memstorageFields ms (memCut σp c) ∗
          "%Hpb" ∷ ⌜uint.Z σp.prev.index' + ↑σp.ents.length < 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗ "Hcut" ∷ memCutInv γs σp c)

theorem storApp_hd (σ : StorState) (h : w64) (q : List EntryM) : storApp { prev := σ.prev, ents :=
    σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd
    := h } q = storApp σ q

theorem memView_termAt_below (σ σ0 : StorState) (H : MemView σ σ0) (Hab : PendAbove σ σ.pend) (Hpo :
    σ.pend ≠ [] → PendOk σ σ.pend) (i t : w64) (Ht : termAt σ0.prev σ0.ents i = some t) (Hi : uint.Z
    i ≤ uint.Z σ.fl) (Hge : uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z i) : termAt σ.prev σ.ents i = some t

theorem memStorCompacted.proj_scs (σ : StorState) (ci t : w64) : (memStorCompacted σ ci t).scs =
    σ.scs

theorem DataEq.trans {a b c : StorState} (h1 : DataEq a b) (h2 : DataEq b c) : DataEq a c

theorem FloorKept.of_above {a b : StorState} (h1 : uint.Z a.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z b.prev.index') (h2
    : uint.Z a.hd ≤ uint.Z b.prev.index') : FloorKept a b

theorem EpOk.snoc {E : List MemEp} {x : MemEp} (H : EpOk E) (hx : ∀ (e : MemEp), E.getLast? = some e
    → epK e <+: x.snd.fst) : EpOk (E ++ [x])

theorem memFlLb_persistent (γs : MemStorNames) (x : w64) : Persistent (memFlLb γs x)

theorem memStorApplied.proj_pend (snap : SnapshotM) : (memStorApplied snap).pend = []

theorem memCut_drop {σ : StorState} {c : entryID} (h : CutOk σ c) (lo hi : w64) (hlo : uint.Z
    c.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z lo) (hhi : uint.Z lo < uint.Z hi) : List.drop (uint.Z lo - uint.Z c.index'
    - 1).toNat (List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z c.index' - 1).toNat (List.drop (uint.Z c.index' -
    uint.Z σ.prev.index').toNat σ.ents)) = List.drop (uint.Z lo - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat
    (List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents)

theorem HistOk.snoc {L : List StorState} {x : StorState} (H : HistOk L) (hle : ∀ (w : StorState),
    L.getLast? = some w → uint.Z w.fl ≤ uint.Z x.fl) (hhd : ∀ (w : StorState), L.getLast? = some w →
    uint.Z w.hd ≤ uint.Z x.hd) (hk : ∀ (w : StorState), L.getLast? = some w → FloorKept w x) (hx :
    uint.Z x.fl ≤ uint.Z x.hd ∧ uint.Z x.hd ≤ stLast x) (hp : x.pend = []) (hi : PlogWf x.prev
    x.ents) : HistOk (L ++ [x])

theorem memStorCompacted.proj_ents (σ : StorState) (ci t : w64) : (memStorCompacted σ ci t).ents =
    List.drop (uint.Z ci - uint.Z σ.prev.index').toNat σ.ents

theorem CutOk.app {σ : StorState} {c : entryID} (h : CutOk σ c) (p : List EntryM) (hp : ∀ (e0 :
    EntryM), p.head? = some e0 → uint.Z c.index' < uint.Z e0.Index') (hok : ∀ (e0 : EntryM), p.head?
    = some e0 → uint.Z e0.Index' ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length + 1) : CutOk { prev :=
    σ.prev, ents := storApp σ p, ss := σ.ss, pend := [], scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
    fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd } c

theorem memSnapCreated_snapId (σ : StorState) (i t : w64) (oc : Option ConfStateM) (bs : List w8) :
    snapId (memSnapCreated σ i t oc bs) = { term' := t, index' := i }

theorem memView_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (σ σp : StorState) : ⊢ memView
    γs σ -∗ memInvGhost γs σp -∗ ⌜MemView σ σp⌝ ∗ memView γs σ ∗ memInvGhost γs σp

def memEp_countable : Pos.Countable MemEp :=
  inferInstance

theorem hdLb_pending {D L Dc H : List StorState} {abs a0 w : StorState} {x : w64} (hDL : D <+: L)
    (hDne : D ≠ []) (hR : RaiseOnly D (List.drop D.length L)) (hok : HistOk (H ++ [abs])) (hw :
    L.getLast? = some w) (hx : uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z w.hd) (hL : L <+: H ++ [abs] ∨ H ++ [abs] <+: L)
    (hD : D <+: Dc) (hDc : Dc <+: H) (hH : H.getLast? = some a0) : uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z a0.hd ∨ DataEq
    a0 abs

def memSnapOwn (ms : Loc) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ sp sv,
      "Hsnapshot" ∷
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"snapshot" ms) sp
            (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Hsnap" ∷ ownSnapM sp (DFrac.own 1) sv ∗
          "%Hsnap_id" ∷
            ⌜snapId sv = σ.ss ∧
                sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists = σ.scs ∧ sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave' = σ.sal ∧ sv.Data' = σ.sdat⌝)

theorem memView_entries (σ σp : StorState) (H : MemView σ σp) (lo hi : w64) (Hr : uint.Z
    σ.prev.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z lo ∧ uint.Z lo < uint.Z hi ∧ uint.Z hi ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' +
    ↑σ.ents.length + 1) (Hb : PendFrom σ (uint.Z hi)) : (uint.Z σp.prev.index' + 1 ≤ uint.Z lo ∧
    uint.Z lo < uint.Z hi ∧ uint.Z hi ≤ uint.Z σp.prev.index' + ↑σp.ents.length + 1) ∧ List.take
    (uint.Z hi - uint.Z σp.prev.index' - 1).toNat σp.ents = List.take (uint.Z hi - uint.Z
    σ.prev.index' - 1).toNat σ.ents ∧ σp.prev = σ.prev

theorem memCut.proj_hd (σ : StorState) (c : entryID) : (memCut σ c).hd = σ.hd

theorem storCS.proj_Learners' (σ : StorState) : (storCS σ).Learners' = σ.scs.learners

theorem PlogWf_storApp (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) (H : PlogWf σ.prev σ.ents) (Hp : ∀ (e0 :
    EntryM), p.head? = some e0 → uint.Z σ.prev.index' < uint.Z e0.Index' ∧ uint.Z e0.Index' ≤ uint.Z
    σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length + 1 ∧ ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM), p[k]? = some e → uint.Z e.Index'
    = uint.Z e0.Index' + ↑k) : PlogWf σ.prev (storApp σ p)

def memSnapKeys (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜k = 1⌝ ∗ memKey γs.lk ∗ memKey γs.ok ∨
      ⌜k = 2⌝ ∗ memKey γs.lk ∗ memKey γs.ak ∨ ⌜k = 3⌝ ∗ memKey γs.ok ∗ memKey γs.ak)

def MemEp : Type :=
  StorState × List StorState × List StorState

theorem memView_term (σ σp : StorState) (H : MemView σ σp) (i0 : w64) (Hr : uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤
    uint.Z i0 ∧ uint.Z i0 ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length) (Hb : PendFrom σ (uint.Z i0 + 1))
    : (uint.Z σp.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z i0 ∧ uint.Z i0 ≤ uint.Z σp.prev.index' + ↑σp.ents.length) ∧
    termAt σp.prev σp.ents i0 = termAt σ.prev σ.ents i0

theorem termAt_storApp_below (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) (i : w64) (Hpo : ∀ (e0 : EntryM),
    p.head? = some e0 → uint.Z i < uint.Z e0.Index' ∧ uint.Z e0.Index' ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' +
    ↑σ.ents.length + 1) (Hge : uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z i) : termAt σ.prev (storApp σ p) i =
    termAt σ.prev σ.ents i

def memStorMeta (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (hs : HardStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ n hp,
      "#Hinit" ∷ isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
        "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isMutex (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"Mutex" ms) (memstorageInv ms γs) ∗
          "HhardState" ∷
              typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"hardState" ms)
                hp (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
            "#Hhs" ∷ hsOpt hp hs ∗
              "Hcs_initialState" ∷
                typedPointsto
                  (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats
                    go!"initialState"
                    (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats" ms))
                  n (DFrac.own 1))

theorem storAbsorb_idle {σ : StorState} (h : σ.pend = []) : storAbsorb σ = σ

theorem memSnapCreated.proj_Metadata' (σ : StorState) (i t : w64) (oc : Option ConfStateM) (bs :
    List w8) : (memSnapCreated σ i t oc bs).Metadata' = { ConfState' := oc.getD (storCS σ), Index'
    := i, Term' := t }

theorem RaiseOnly.last {D L : List StorState} {a w : StorState} (hD : D <+: L) (hR : RaiseOnly D
    (List.drop D.length L)) (ha : D.getLast? = some a) (hw : L.getLast? = some w) : DataEq w a

theorem HistOk.prefix {L1 L2 : List StorState} (h : L1 <+: L2) (H : HistOk L2) : HistOk L1

def memStorCut (γs : MemStorNames) (n : Int) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(monoNatLbOwn γs.bd n.toNat ∗ ⌜n ≤ γs.cap⌝)

theorem memSnapCertOk_of_sv (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (sv : SnapshotM) (h : snapId sv =
    σ.ss ∧ sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists = σ.scs ∧ sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave' = σ.sal ∧
    sv.Data' = σ.sdat) : memStorCert γs (snapTrip sv sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists) ⊢ memSnapCertOk
    γs σ

theorem memStorCert_persistent (γs : MemStorNames) (k : SnapTrip) : Persistent (memStorCert γs k)

def ownMemoryStorage (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("#Hinit" ∷ isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
      "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isMutex (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"Mutex" ms) (memstorageInv ms γs) ∗
        "Hview" ∷ memView γs σ ∗
          "Hsn" ∷ memSnapShare ms γs ∗ "%Hbounded" ∷ ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length < 2 ^ 61⌝)

theorem memInvGhost_key [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (σp : StorState) : ⊢
    memInvGhost γs σp -∗ memKey γs.lk ∗ (memKey γs.lk -∗ memInvGhost γs σp)

def memStorCreated (σ : StorState) (i t : w64) (oc : Option ConfStateM) (bs : List w8) : StorState
    :=
  { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := { term' := t, index' := i }, pend := σ.pend,
    scs := (memSnapCreated σ i t oc bs).Metadata'.ConfState'.lists,
    sal := (memSnapCreated σ i t oc bs).Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave', sdat := bs, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }

theorem memStorApplied.proj_ss (snap : SnapshotM) : (memStorApplied snap).ss = snapId snap

theorem memStorCompacted.proj_sal (σ : StorState) (ci t : w64) : (memStorCompacted σ ci t).sal =
    σ.sal

def PendView (σ : StorState) (hist : List StorState) (E : List MemEp) (H D : List StorState) (h0 :
    w64) : Prop :=
  σ.pend ≠ [] ∧
    E.getLast? =
        some
          ({ prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
              fl := σ.fl, hd := h0 },
            H, D) ∧
      epK
            ({ prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                fl := σ.fl, hd := h0 },
              H, D) <+:
          hist ∧
        RaiseOnly
            (epK
              ({ prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                  fl := σ.fl, hd := h0 },
                H, D))
            (List.drop
              (epK
                  ({ prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                      sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := h0 },
                    H, D)).length
              hist) ∧
          hist.getLast? = some (storAbsorb σ) ∧
            H.getLast? =
                some
                  { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := [], scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                    fl := σ.fl, hd := h0 } ∧
              uint.Z h0 ≤ uint.Z σ.hd ∧
                HdAbove
                    { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                      sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := h0 }
                    σ.pend ∧
                  PendAbove σ σ.pend ∧ D <+: H ∧ D ≠ [] ∧ RaiseOnly D (List.drop D.length H) ∧ PendOk σ σ.pend

def memQ : Qp :=
  (Qp.half 1).half

theorem memStorage_terms (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (ts : List w64) (Hp : σ.pend
    = []) (Hl : ↑ts.length ≤ uint.Z σ.hd) (Ht : TermsOn σ ts) : ⊢ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ -∗
    ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ∗ memTermsAt γs ts

theorem memSnapTokG_congr (γs : MemStorNames) (σ σ' : StorState) (h1 : snapPart σ' = snapPart σ) (h2
    : σ'.prev = σ.prev) : memSnapTokG γs σ ⊢ memSnapTokG γs σ'

theorem memSnap_update [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (a b c σ' : StorState) : ⊢
    ghostVar γs.sn memQ a -∗ ghostVar γs.sn memQ b -∗ ghostVar γs.sn (Qp.half 1) c ==∗ ghostVar
    γs.sn memQ (snapPart σ') ∗ ghostVar γs.sn memQ (snapPart σ') ∗ ghostVar γs.sn (Qp.half 1)
    (snapPart σ')

theorem EpOk.prefix {E1 E2 : List MemEp} (h : E1 <+: E2) (H : EpOk E2) : EpOk E1

theorem storApp_length_ge (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) (m : Nat) (Hm : ∀ (e0 : EntryM), p.head?
    = some e0 → ↑m ≤ uint.Z e0.Index' - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1) (Hlen : m ≤ σ.ents.length) : m ≤
    (storApp σ p).length

theorem memStorCompacted.proj_sdat (σ : StorState) (ci t : w64) : (memStorCompacted σ ci t).sdat =
    σ.sdat

theorem memHdLb_persistent (γs : MemStorNames) (x : w64) : Persistent (memHdLb γs x)

def memStorEmpty : StorState :=
  { prev := { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 }, ents := [], ss := { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 }, pend := [] }

theorem memStorApplied.proj_ents (snap : SnapshotM) : (memStorApplied snap).ents = []

theorem memSnap_put [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (σ :
    StorState) (E : CoPset) (HE : ↑memSnapN ⊆ E) : ⊢ inv memSnapN (memSnapInv ms γs) -∗ ghostVar
    γs.sw (Qp.half 1) k -∗ memSnapOwn ms σ -∗ ghostVar γs.sn (Qp.half 1) (snapPart σ) -∗
    memSnapCertOk γs σ ={E}=∗ memSnapKeys γs k

def memCertAuth (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  monoListAuthOwn γs.cert 1 []

theorem memCut_self (σ : StorState) : memCut σ σ.prev = σ

def memAppendedTok (_ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ E H D,
      "Hdone" ∷
          monoListAuthOwn γs.done (Qp.half 1)
            (H ++
              [storAbsorb
                  { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                    fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }]) ∗
        "#Hhlb" ∷
            monoListLbOwn γs.hist
              (H ++
                [storAbsorb
                    { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
                      fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }]) ∗
          "Hep" ∷ monoListAuthOwn γs.ep (Qp.half 1) E ∗
            "%Hbnd" ∷ ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑(storApp σ p).length < 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗
              "%Hhok" ∷
                ⌜E.getLast? =
                      some
                        ({ prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                            sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd },
                          H, D) ∧
                    EpOk E ∧
                      HistOk
                        (H ++
                          [storAbsorb
                              { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
                                sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }])⌝)

def memTermsPre (γs : MemStorNames) (ts : List w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(memTermsAt γs ts ∨
      ∃ Ec e L,
        monoListLbOwn γs.ep Ec ∗
          monoListLbOwn γs.hist L ∗
            ⌜Ec.getLast? = some e ∧
                epK e <+: L ∧
                  RaiseOnly (epK e) (List.drop (epK e).length L) ∧
                    HistOk L ∧ ∃ w, L.getLast? = some w ∧ ↑ts.length ≤ uint.Z w.hd ∧ TermsOn w ts⌝)

def memSnapCertOk (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜σ.ss.index' = W64 0⌝ ∨ memStorCert γs σ.trip)

def memCut (σ : StorState) (c : entryID) : StorState :=
  { prev := c, ents := List.drop (uint.Z c.index' - uint.Z σ.prev.index').toNat σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend,
    scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }

theorem storCS.proj_Voters' (σ : StorState) : (storCS σ).Voters' = σ.scs.voters

theorem memSnapCertOk_sv (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (sv : SnapshotM) (h : snapId sv = σ.ss
    ∧ sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists = σ.scs ∧ sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave' = σ.sal ∧ sv.Data'
    = σ.sdat) : memSnapCertOk γs σ ⊢ ⌜sv.Metadata'.Index' = W64 0⌝ ∨ memStorCert γs (snapTrip sv
    sv.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists)

theorem EpOk.last_cases {E1 E2 : List MemEp} {e1 e2 : MemEp} (h : E1 <+: E2) (H : EpOk E2) (h1 :
    E1.getLast? = some e1) (h2 : E2.getLast? = some e2) : e1 = e2 ∨ epK e1 <+: e2.snd.fst

def DataEq (a b : StorState) : Prop :=
  a.prev = b.prev ∧ a.ents = b.ents ∧ a.ss = b.ss ∧ a.scs = b.scs ∧ a.sal = b.sal ∧ a.pend = b.pend ∧ a.sdat = b.sdat

theorem memStorApplied.proj_fl (snap : SnapshotM) : (memStorApplied snap).fl = 0

theorem memFlLb_le [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (x y : w64) (h : uint.Z y ≤
    uint.Z x) : memFlLb γs x ⊢ memFlLb γs y

theorem memCut.proj_sdat (σ : StorState) (c : entryID) : (memCut σ c).sdat = σ.sdat

def RaiseOnly (D R : List StorState) : Prop :=
  ∀ (w : StorState), w ∈ R → ∃ a, D.getLast? = some a ∧ DataEq w a

theorem EpOk.prefix_last {E : List MemEp} {e : MemEp} (H : EpOk E) (he : E.getLast? = some e) (a :
    MemEp) : a ∈ E → epK a <+: epK e

theorem memView_set [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (σ σp σ' : StorState) (Hidle :
    σ.pend = []) (H' : σ'.pend = []) (Hfl : σ'.fl = σ.fl) (Hhd : σ'.hd = σ.hd) (Hlst : uint.Z σ.hd ≤
    stLast σ') (Hidx' : PlogWf σ'.prev σ'.ents) (Hpv : uint.Z σp.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z
    σ'.prev.index') (Hfv : uint.Z σ.hd ≤ uint.Z σ'.prev.index') : ⊢ memView γs σ -∗ memInvGhost γs
    σp ==∗ ⌜DataEq σp σ⌝ ∗ memView γs σ' ∗ memInvGhost γs σ'

def memstorageFields (ms : Loc) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ hp es dummy nfi nli nen nte nsn,
      "HhardState" ∷
          typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"hardState" ms) hp
            (DFrac.own (Qp.half 1)) ∗
        "Hents_f" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"ents" ms) es (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          "Hents" ∷ entsRO es (dummy :: σ.ents) ∗
            "Hents_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap Loc es (DFrac.own 1) ∗
              "%Hdummy" ∷ ⌜dummy.Index' = σ.prev.index' ∧ dummy.Term' = σ.prev.term'⌝ ∗
                "Hcs_firstIndex" ∷
                    typedPointsto
                      (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats
                        go!"firstIndex"
                        (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats" ms))
                      nfi (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                  "Hcs_lastIndex" ∷
                      typedPointsto
                        (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats
                          go!"lastIndex"
                          (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats" ms))
                        nli (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                    "Hcs_entries" ∷
                        typedPointsto
                          (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats go!"entries"
                            (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats" ms))
                          nen (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                      "Hcs_term" ∷
                          typedPointsto
                            (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats go!"term"
                              (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats"
                                ms))
                            nte (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                        "Hcs_snapshot" ∷
                          typedPointsto
                            (structFieldRef inMemStorageCallStats go!"snapshot"
                              (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"callStats"
                                ms))
                            nsn (DFrac.own 1))

def MemView (σ σp : StorState) : Prop :=
  σp.prev = σ.prev ∧
    (σp.ss = σ.ss ∧ σp.scs = σ.scs ∧ σp.sal = σ.sal ∧ σp.sdat = σ.sdat) ∧
      (σp.ents = σ.ents ∨ σ.pend ≠ [] ∧ σp.ents = storApp σ σ.pend) ∧ (σ.pend = [] → σp.ents = σ.ents)

def memFlLb (γs : MemStorNames) (x : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ Ec e, monoListLbOwn γs.ep Ec ∗ ⌜Ec.getLast? = some e ∧ uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z e.fst.fl⌝)

def memCsArg (cs : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (oc : Option ConfStateM) : IProp GF :=
  match oc with
  | none => iprop(⌜cs = null⌝)
  | some c => ownCSM cs dq c

theorem memStorApplied.proj_hd (snap : SnapshotM) : (memStorApplied snap).hd = 0

theorem termAt_le_last {prev : entryID} {ents : List EntryM} {i t : w64} (h : termAt prev ents i =
    some t) : uint.Z i ≤ uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length

def HistOk (L : List StorState) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise (fun a b => uint.Z a.fl ≤ uint.Z b.fl ∧ uint.Z a.hd ≤ uint.Z b.hd ∧ FloorKept a b) L ∧
    ∀ (b : StorState), b ∈ L → (uint.Z b.fl ≤ uint.Z b.hd ∧ uint.Z b.hd ≤ stLast b) ∧ b.pend = [] ∧ PlogWf b.prev b.ents

def storCS (σ : StorState) : ConfStateM :=
  { Voters' := σ.scs.voters, Learners' := σ.scs.learners, VotersOutgoing' := σ.scs.outgoing,
    LearnersNext' := σ.scs.learnersNext, AutoLeave' := σ.sal }

theorem memFloorTok_flLb [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (x : w64) :
    memFloorTok ms γs x ⊢ memFlLb γs x

theorem ownMemoryStorage_init [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ :
    StorState) : ⊢ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ -∗ isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
    ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ

theorem memFloorTok_hdLb [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (x : w64) :
    memFloorTok ms γs x ⊢ memHdLb γs x

theorem memStorCompacted.proj_hd (σ : StorState) (ci t : w64) : (memStorCompacted σ ci t).hd = σ.hd

theorem memStorage_absorb [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ1 σ :
    StorState) (p : List EntryM) : ⊢ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ1 -∗ memAppendedTok ms γs σ p ==∗ ⌜{
    prev := σ1.prev, ents := σ1.ents, ss := σ1.ss, pend := σ1.pend, scs := σ1.scs, sal := σ1.sal,
    sdat := σ1.sdat, fl := σ1.fl, hd := σ.hd } = { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend
    := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }⌝ ∗ ownMemoryStorage
    ms γs (storAbsorb σ1)

def memSnapInv (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ w,
      ghostVar γs.sw (Qp.half 1) w ∗ (⌜w = 0⌝ ∗ ghostVar γs.sw (Qp.half 1) 0 ∗ memSnapHome ms γs ∨ memSnapKeys γs w))

theorem memSnapCreated.proj_Data' (σ : StorState) (i t : w64) (oc : Option ConfStateM) (bs : List
    w8) : (memSnapCreated σ i t oc bs).Data' = bs

def memTermsAt (γs : MemStorNames) (ts : List w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ D L,
      monoListLbOwn γs.done D ∗
        monoListLbOwn γs.hist L ∗
          ⌜D <+: L ∧
              D ≠ [] ∧
                RaiseOnly D (List.drop D.length L) ∧
                  HistOk L ∧ ∃ w, L.getLast? = some w ∧ ↑ts.length ≤ uint.Z w.hd ∧ TermsOn w ts⌝)

theorem memSnapOwn_congr [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (σ σ' : StorState) (h1 : σ'.ss =
    σ.ss) (h2 : σ'.scs = σ.scs) (h3 : σ'.sal = σ.sal) (h4 : σ'.sdat = σ.sdat) : memSnapOwn ms σ ⊢
    memSnapOwn ms σ'

def memStorCompacted (σ : StorState) (ci t : w64) : StorState :=
  { prev := { term' := t, index' := ci }, ents := List.drop (uint.Z ci - uint.Z σ.prev.index').toNat σ.ents, ss := σ.ss,
    pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd }

theorem memKey_excl [package_sem : Assumptions] (γ : GName) : ⊢ memKey γ -∗ memKey γ -∗ False

def memSnapTok (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop("#Hinit" ∷ isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.raft.v3 ∗
      "#Hmu" ∷ sync.isMutex (structFieldRef MemoryStorage go!"Mutex" ms) (memstorageInv ms γs) ∗
        "#Hsinv" ∷ inv memSnapN (memSnapInv ms γs) ∗
          "Hak" ∷ memKey γs.ak ∗ "Hsv" ∷ ghostVar γs.sn memQ (snapPart σ) ∗ "Hcbt" ∷ ghostVar γs.cb (Qp.half 1) σ.prev)

theorem monoAuthLb_keep {A : Type} [Pos.Countable A] (γ : GName) (q : Qp) (l1 l2 : List A) :
    monoListAuthOwn γ q l1 ∗ monoListLbOwn γ l2 ⊢ (monoListAuthOwn γ q l1 ∗ monoListLbOwn γ l2) ∗
    ⌜l2 <+: l1⌝

theorem monoAuth_halves [package_sem : Assumptions] {A : Type} [Pos.Countable A] (γ : GName) (l :
    List A) : monoListAuthOwn γ 1 l ⊣⊢ monoListAuthOwn γ (Qp.half 1) l ∗ monoListAuthOwn γ (Qp.half
    1) l

theorem memFlLb_view [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (x : w64) : ⊢
    memView γs σ -∗ memFlLb γs x -∗ ⌜uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z σ.fl⌝ ∗ memView γs σ

theorem memSnapCreated_confState (σ : StorState) (i t : w64) (c : ConfStateM) (bs : List w8) :
    (memSnapCreated σ i t (some c) bs).Metadata'.ConfState' = c

theorem memSnap_take [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) (E :
    CoPset) (HE : ↑memSnapN ⊆ E) : ⊢ inv memSnapN (memSnapInv ms γs) -∗ memSnapKeys γs k ={E}=∗ ▷
    memSnapHome ms γs ∗ ghostVar γs.sw (Qp.half 1) k

theorem RaiseOnly.nil (D : List StorState) : RaiseOnly D []

theorem raiseOnly_between {D Dc L : List StorState} {a b : StorState} (h1 : D <+: Dc) (h2 : Dc <+:
    L) (hR : RaiseOnly D (List.drop D.length L)) (ha : D.getLast? = some a) (hb : Dc.getLast? = some
    b) : DataEq b a

def FloorKept (a b : StorState) : Prop :=
  uint.Z a.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z b.prev.index' ∧
    ∀ (j : w64),
      uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z a.hd → uint.Z b.prev.index' < uint.Z j → termAt b.prev b.ents j = termAt a.prev a.ents j

theorem snapPart_inj {σ σ' : StorState} (h : snapPart σ = snapPart σ') : σ.ss = σ'.ss ∧ σ.scs =
    σ'.scs ∧ σ.sal = σ'.sal ∧ σ.sdat = σ'.sdat

theorem ownMemoryStorage_bounded [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ :
    StorState) : ⊢ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ -∗ ⌜uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length < 2 ^ 61⌝ ∗
    ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ

theorem HistOk.last_kept {L1 L2 : List StorState} {a b : StorState} (h : L1 <+: L2) (H : HistOk L2)
    (ha : L1.getLast? = some a) (hb : L2.getLast? = some b) : FloorKept a b

theorem storCS.proj_VotersOutgoing' (σ : StorState) : (storCS σ).VotersOutgoing' = σ.scs.outgoing

theorem memCut.proj_pend (σ : StorState) (c : entryID) : (memCut σ c).pend = σ.pend

theorem FloorKept.trans {a w x : StorState} (h1 : FloorKept a w) (h2 : FloorKept w x) (hfl : uint.Z
    a.hd ≤ uint.Z w.hd) : FloorKept a x

theorem memStorCompacted.proj_prev (σ : StorState) (ci t : w64) : (memStorCompacted σ ci t).prev = {
    term' := t, index' := ci }

def memSnapHome (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ σp, memSnapOwn ms σp ∗ ghostVar γs.sn (Qp.half 1) (snapPart σp) ∗ memSnapCertOk γs σp)

theorem DataEq.stLast {a b : StorState} (h : DataEq a b) : stLast a = stLast b

def memInvGhost (γs : MemStorNames) (σp : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ D Ec e,
      monoListAuthOwn γs.done (Qp.half 1) D ∗
        monoListLbOwn γs.hist D ∗
          monoListLbOwn γs.ep Ec ∗ ⌜D.getLast? = some σp ∧ HistOk D ∧ Ec.getLast? = some e ∧ D <+: epK e⌝ ∗ memKey γs.lk)

theorem HistOk.le_last {L : List StorState} {w : StorState} (H : HistOk L) (hw : L.getLast? = some
    w) (a : StorState) : a ∈ L → uint.Z a.fl ≤ uint.Z w.fl

theorem memHdLb_le [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (x y : w64) (h : uint.Z y ≤
    uint.Z x) : memHdLb γs x ⊢ memHdLb γs y

def snapTrip_countable : Pos.Countable SnapTrip :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun k =>
      Pos.Countable.encode (((k.sid, ((k.cl.voters, k.cl.learners), k.cl.outgoing), k.cl.learnersNext), k.al), k.dat))
    ⋯

theorem FloorKept.of_data {a b : StorState} (h1 : b.prev = a.prev) (h2 : b.ents = a.ents) :
    FloorKept a b

theorem RaiseOnly.of_longer {K K' L : List StorState} (h1 : K <+: K') (h2 : K' <+: L) (hR :
    RaiseOnly K (List.drop K.length L)) : RaiseOnly K' (List.drop K'.length L)

theorem memTermsAt_lock [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (σp : StorState) (ts : List
    w64) : ⊢ memTermsAt γs ts -∗ memInvGhost γs σp -∗ ⌜TermsOn σp ts⌝ ∗ memInvGhost γs σp

def CutOk (σ : StorState) (c : entryID) : Prop :=
  uint.Z σ.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z c.index' ∧ uint.Z c.index' ≤ stLast σ ∧ termAt σ.prev σ.ents c.index' = some c.term'

def memSnapTokG (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(ghostVar γs.sn memQ (snapPart σ) ∗ ghostVar γs.cb (Qp.half 1) σ.prev)

theorem memStorApplied.proj_sal (snap : SnapshotM) : (memStorApplied snap).sal =
    snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave'

def memView (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ hist E,
      ⌜HistOk hist ∧ EpOk E⌝ ∗
        monoListAuthOwn γs.hist 1 hist ∗
          ((monoListAuthOwn γs.ep 1 E ∗
              ⌜σ.pend = [] ∧ hist.getLast? = some σ ∧ ∃ e, E.getLast? = some e ∧ epK e <+: hist⌝ ∗
                ∃ D,
                  monoListAuthOwn γs.done (Qp.half 1) D ∗ ⌜D <+: hist ∧ D ≠ [] ∧ RaiseOnly D (List.drop D.length hist)⌝) ∨
            monoListAuthOwn γs.ep (Qp.half 1) E ∗ ∃ H D h0, ⌜PendView σ hist E H D h0⌝ ∗ monoListLbOwn γs.done D))

def memCutInv (γs : MemStorNames) (σp : StorState) (c : entryID) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ S,
      "Hcb" ∷ ghostVar γs.cb (Qp.half 1) c ∗
        "Hbd" ∷ monoNatAuthOwn γs.bd 1 (uint.Z c.index').toNat ∗
          "#Hcfl" ∷ (⌜c = σp.prev⌝ ∨ memFlLb γs c.index') ∗
            "Hsq" ∷ ghostVar γs.sn memQ (snapPart S) ∗
              "%Hcok" ∷ ⌜CutOk σp c ∧ uint.Z c.index' ≤ uint.Z S.ss.index'⌝ ∗
                "%Hccap" ∷ ⌜uint.Z c.index' ≤ γs.cap⌝ ∗
                  "#Hsrel" ∷
                    (⌜S.ss = σp.ss ∧ S.scs = σp.scs ∧ S.sal = σp.sal ∧ S.sdat = σp.sdat⌝ ∨
                      ⌜uint.Z σp.ss.index' < uint.Z S.ss.index' ∧
                            uint.Z σp.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z S.ss.index' ∧
                              termAt σp.prev σp.ents S.ss.index' = some S.ss.term'⌝ ∗
                        memHdLb γs S.ss.index'))

theorem memStorCert_of_lb (γs : MemStorNames) (L : List CertKey) (e : CertKey) (k : SnapTrip) (he :
    e ∈ L) (hc : certCovers e k) : monoListLbOwn γs.cert L ⊢ memStorCert γs k

theorem storCS.proj_AutoLeave' (σ : StorState) : (storCS σ).AutoLeave' = σ.sal

theorem memCut.proj_prev (σ : StorState) (c : entryID) : (memCut σ c).prev = c

theorem memTermsAt_hdLb [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (ts : List w64) (x : w64)
    (hx : uint.Z x ≤ ↑ts.length) : memTermsAt γs ts ⊢ memHdLb γs x

def EpOk (E : List MemEp) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise (fun a b => epK a <+: b.snd.fst) E

def StorState.trip (σ : StorState) : SnapTrip :=
  { sid := σ.ss, cl := σ.scs, al := σ.sal, dat := σ.sdat }

def stLast (σ : StorState) : Int :=
  uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length

theorem memStorage_handout [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ :
    StorState) (p : List EntryM) (Hpo : σ.pend = [] ∧ PendOk σ p ∧ PendAbove σ p ∧ HdAbove σ p) : ⊢
    ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ==∗ ownMemoryStorage ms γs { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss :=
    σ.ss, pend := p, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := σ.fl, hd := σ.hd } ∗
    memAppendTok ms γs σ p

theorem termAt_memCut {σ : StorState} {c : entryID} (h : CutOk σ c) (i : w64) (hi : uint.Z c.index'
    ≤ uint.Z i) : termAt c (List.drop (uint.Z c.index' - uint.Z σ.prev.index').toNat σ.ents) i =
    termAt σ.prev σ.ents i

def storState_countable : Pos.Countable StorState :=
  Pos.Countable.ofInjective
    (fun σ =>
      Pos.Countable.encode
        ((((((((σ.prev, σ.ents), σ.ss), σ.pend), ((σ.scs.voters, σ.scs.learners), σ.scs.outgoing), σ.scs.learnersNext),
                σ.sal),
              σ.sdat),
            σ.fl),
          σ.hd))
    ⋯

theorem memStorage_floor [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState)
    (x h : w64) (Hx : (σ.pend = [] ∨ x = σ.fl) ∧ uint.Z σ.fl ≤ uint.Z x ∧ uint.Z σ.hd ≤ uint.Z h ∧
    uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z h ∧ (x = σ.fl ∨ uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑σ.ents.length) ∧ (h = σ.hd
    ∨ uint.Z h ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' + ↑(storApp σ σ.pend).length)) : ⊢ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ
    ==∗ ownMemoryStorage ms γs { prev := σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs :=
    σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat, fl := x, hd := h } ∗ memFloorTok ms γs x

theorem storApp_take (σ : StorState) (p : List EntryM) (m : Nat) (Hm : ∀ (e0 : EntryM), p.head? =
    some e0 → ↑m ≤ uint.Z e0.Index' - uint.Z σ.prev.index' - 1) (Hlen : m ≤ σ.ents.length) :
    List.take m (storApp σ p) = List.take m σ.ents

theorem storCS.proj_LearnersNext' (σ : StorState) : (storCS σ).LearnersNext' = σ.scs.learnersNext

def memSnapCreated (σ : StorState) (i t : w64) (oc : Option ConfStateM) (bs : List w8) : SnapshotM
    :=
  { Data' := bs, Metadata' := { ConfState' := oc.getD (storCS σ), Index' := i, Term' := t } }

theorem memSnapKeys_timeless (γs : MemStorNames) (k : Nat) : Timeless (memSnapKeys γs k)

theorem HistOk.last_mono_hd {L1 L2 : List StorState} {a b : StorState} (h : L1 <+: L2) (H : HistOk
    L2) (ha : L1.getLast? = some a) (hb : L2.getLast? = some b) : uint.Z a.hd ≤ uint.Z b.hd

theorem monoHalves_update [package_sem : Assumptions] {A : Type} [Pos.Countable A] (γ : GName) (H H'
    : List A) (h : H <+: H') : ⊢ monoListAuthOwn γ (Qp.half 1) H -∗ monoListAuthOwn γ (Qp.half 1) H
    ==∗ monoListAuthOwn γ (Qp.half 1) H' ∗ monoListAuthOwn γ (Qp.half 1) H'

theorem memCut.proj_ents (σ : StorState) (c : entryID) : (memCut σ c).ents = List.drop (uint.Z
    c.index' - uint.Z σ.prev.index').toNat σ.ents

def memHdLb (γs : MemStorNames) (x : w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ D L,
      monoListLbOwn γs.done D ∗
        monoListLbOwn γs.hist L ∗
          ⌜D <+: L ∧
              D ≠ [] ∧ RaiseOnly D (List.drop D.length L) ∧ HistOk L ∧ ∃ w, L.getLast? = some w ∧ uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z w.hd⌝)

theorem memStorage_termsPre (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (ts : List w64) (Hl :
    ↑ts.length ≤ uint.Z σ.hd) (Ht : TermsOn (storAbsorb σ) ts) : ⊢ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ -∗
    ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ∗ memTermsPre γs ts

def snapPart (σ : StorState) : StorState :=
  { prev := { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 }, ents := [], ss := σ.ss, pend := [], scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal,
    sdat := σ.sdat }

theorem memTermsAt_persistent (γs : MemStorNames) (ts : List w64) : Persistent (memTermsAt γs ts)

def memStorCert (γs : MemStorNames) (k : SnapTrip) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ L, monoListLbOwn γs.cert L ∗ ⌜∃ e, e ∈ L ∧ certCovers e k⌝)

theorem HistOk.last_mono {L1 L2 : List StorState} {a b : StorState} (h : L1 <+: L2) (H : HistOk L2)
    (ha : L1.getLast? = some a) (hb : L2.getLast? = some b) : uint.Z a.fl ≤ uint.Z b.fl

theorem memCut.proj_ss (σ : StorState) (c : entryID) : (memCut σ c).ss = σ.ss

theorem memHdLb_view [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (σ σ0 : StorState) (x t : w64)
    (Ht : termAt σ0.prev σ0.ents x = some t) (Hge : uint.Z σ0.prev.index' ≤ uint.Z x) : ⊢ memView γs
    σ -∗ memInvGhost γs σ0 -∗ memHdLb γs x -∗ ⌜uint.Z x ≤ uint.Z σ.hd ∧ termAt σ.prev (storApp σ
    σ.pend) x = some t⌝ ∗ memView γs σ ∗ memInvGhost γs σ0

theorem memSnapTok_split (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) : memSnapTok ms γs σ ⊣⊢
    memSnapRO ms γs ∗ memKey γs.ak ∗ memSnapTokG γs σ

theorem memStorage_raise_pending (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) (h : w64) (Hp0 :
    σ.pend ≠ []) (Hhh : uint.Z σ.hd ≤ uint.Z h) (Hhl : h = σ.hd ∨ uint.Z h ≤ uint.Z σ.prev.index' +
    ↑(storApp σ σ.pend).length) : ⊢ ownMemoryStorage ms γs σ ==∗ ownMemoryStorage ms γs { prev :=
    σ.prev, ents := σ.ents, ss := σ.ss, pend := σ.pend, scs := σ.scs, sal := σ.sal, sdat := σ.sdat,
    fl := σ.fl, hd := h } ∗ memFloorTok ms γs σ.fl

theorem memstorageFields_congr [package_sem : Assumptions] (ms : Loc) (σ σ' : StorState) (h1 :
    σ'.prev = σ.prev) (h2 : σ'.ents = σ.ents) : memstorageFields ms σ ⊢ memstorageFields ms σ'

def epK (e : MemEp) : List StorState :=
  e.snd.fst ++ [storAbsorb e.fst]

theorem memTermsAt_receipt (ms : Loc) (γs : MemStorNames) (ts : List w64) (σ : StorState) (p : List
    EntryM) : ⊢ memTermsPre γs ts -∗ memAppendedTok ms γs σ p -∗ memAppendedTok ms γs σ p ∗
    memTermsAt γs ts

theorem monoAuth_agree_keep {A : Type} [Pos.Countable A] (γ : GName) (q1 q2 : Qp) (l1 l2 : List A) :
    monoListAuthOwn γ q1 l1 ∗ monoListAuthOwn γ q2 l2 ⊢ (monoListAuthOwn γ q1 l1 ∗ monoListAuthOwn γ
    q2 l2) ∗ ⌜l1 = l2⌝

theorem memStorCompacted.proj_fl (σ : StorState) (ci t : w64) : (memStorCompacted σ ci t).fl = σ.fl

theorem epK_getLast (e : MemEp) : (epK e).getLast? = some (storAbsorb e.fst)

def memStorApplied (snap : SnapshotM) : StorState :=
  { prev := snapId snap, ents := [], ss := snapId snap, pend := [], scs := snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.lists,
    sal := snap.Metadata'.ConfState'.AutoLeave', sdat := snap.Data' }

theorem memView_pend [package_sem : Assumptions] (γs : MemStorNames) (σ : StorState) : ⊢ memView γs
    σ -∗ ⌜PendAbove σ σ.pend ∧ (σ.pend ≠ [] → PendOk σ σ.pend)⌝ ∗ memView γs σ
